BiblicalUsage: Chamash appears once, in Joseph's counsel to Pharaoh: take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe one verse is enough to show Joseph's wisdom: prepare in plenty for the famine you can see coming.
